quarterly_data.signal: Meta's 10-K: capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, were $72.22 billion for the year ended December 31, 2025. At the time of the filing Meta anticipated capital expenditures of approximately $115 billion to $135 billion in 2026 to support its AI efforts and core business.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 capex $72.22 billion (incl. finance-lease principal); 2026 capex outlook ~$115 billion to $135 billion
